title: Banner, backdrops & flags — Horizontal banner artworks
slide_intent: Teach designers to protect a recognizable part of a banner when its length changes. A visitor should still find the program name beside the symbol.
strategic_value: Special Olympics can carry one program lockup across different venues while leaving each banner room for local information.
demonstration: Two strips exchange the white and red fields around the mark. A shorter diagram adds a blue extension field and a double-headed arrow.
practical_value: Keep the program name in Ubuntu Italic and alter the portion beyond the curve to fit the venue, web address, sponsor marks or photograph.

content_islands.name: Adaptation notes
content_islands.spec: Set the heading above a narrow instructions column. Number the notes to match the points on the drawings.

content_islands.name: Banner color pair
content_islands.spec: Stack two long strips of equal size. Place the name and symbol left of the curve and compare the mark on white with its white version on red.

content_islands.name: Adjustable span
content_islands.spec: Add a smaller strip below. Tint the expandable right portion blue and mark its horizontal direction with an arrow.
